blocks.text: New Wave Tropical is an aesthetic design prevalent between the mid-1980s and mid-1990s that blends high-energy rainforest and beach imagery that have motifs from African, Caribbean and Latin cultures with retro-punk, freeform, and art-revival influences. It diffuses a resort-style, playful, leisure vibe with chaos and bold color choices.
Kitsch & Leisure Mix: Balances relaxed, upscale vacation moods with loud, playful, and nostalgic elements.
Artistic Influences: Draws inspiration heavily from Henri Matisse-style cut-out revivals and freeform Pacific punk experimentation.
Colorful Cutouts: Uses irregular, chunky, abstract botanical silhouettes and construction-paper-style shapes.
Wild Saturation: Incorporates electric, high-contrast, hues like turquoise, hot pink, sun-washed yellow and lime green.
